LOGIN.title: User logs in with registered email and password
LOGIN.i_want: to log in with my registered email and password

acceptance_criteria.given: the user enters a valid email and password
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the login button
acceptance_criteria.then: the user is successfully logged in

acceptance_criteria.given: the user enters an invalid email or password
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the login button
acceptance_criteria.then: an error message is displayed indicating the login failed

LOGIN.title: Password must be 11 to 20 characters and contain at least one ₹ or $ symbol
LOGIN.i_want: to ensure my password meets the specified criteria

acceptance_criteria.given: the user enters a password with 10 characters
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the login button
acceptance_criteria.then: an error message is displayed indicating the password is too short

acceptance_criteria.given: the user enters a password with 21 characters
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the login button
acceptance_criteria.then: an error message is displayed indicating the password is too long

acceptance_criteria.given: the user enters a password without any ₹ or $ symbol
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the login button
acceptance_criteria.then: an error message is displayed indicating the password must contain at least one ₹ or $ symbol

LOGIN.title: Account is locked after 4 consecutive failed login attempts
LOGIN.i_want: to prevent unauthorized access to my account

acceptance_criteria.given: the user enters an incorrect password 4 times
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the login button
acceptance_criteria.then: the account is locked

acceptance_criteria.given: the user enters an incorrect password 5 times
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the login button
acceptance_criteria.then: the account is locked

LOGIN.title: Locked accounts are automatically unlocked after 23 minutes
LOGIN.i_want: to regain access to my account after a period of inactivity
LOGIN.so_that: I can continue using my account

acceptance_criteria.given: the user's account is locked
acceptance_criteria.when: 23 minutes pass
acceptance_criteria.then: the account is automatically unlocked

acceptance_criteria.given: the user's account is locked
acceptance_criteria.when: 22 minutes and 59 seconds pass
acceptance_criteria.then: the account remains locked

LOGIN.title: A 7-digit OTP is sent to the registered mobile for new device logins. OTP is valid for 90 seconds
LOGIN.i_want: to receive a one-time password for new device logins

acceptance_criteria.given: the user logs in from a new device
acceptance_criteria.when: the system sends a 7-digit OTP to the registered mobile
acceptance_criteria.then: the user receives the OTP via SMS

acceptance_criteria.given: the user enters an incorrect OTP 3 times
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the login button
acceptance_criteria.then: the login attempt fails and the OTP expires after 90 seconds

LOGIN.title: Remember Me keeps the user logged in for 9 days
LOGIN.i_want: to stay logged in for a longer period
LOGIN.so_that: I don't have to log in every day

acceptance_criteria.given: the user checks the 'Remember Me' box
acceptance_criteria.when: the user logs in
acceptance_criteria.then: the user remains logged in for 9 days

acceptance_criteria.given: the user unchecks the 'Remember Me' box
acceptance_criteria.when: the user logs in
acceptance_criteria.then: the user is logged out after 9 days

CART.title: Add products to the cart
CART.i_want: to add up to 15 different products to the cart
CART.so_that: I can keep track of items I want to purchase

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: the user adds 15 different products to the cart
acceptance_criteria.then: the system allows the addition of all 15 products

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: the user tries to add the 16th product to the cart
acceptance_criteria.then: the system prevents the addition and displays a message indicating the maximum limit is reached

CART.title: Set quantity for products in the cart
CART.i_want: to set the quantity for each product in the cart up to 5
CART.so_that: I can adjust the quantity of items I want to purchase

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: the user sets the quantity of a product to 5
acceptance_criteria.then: the system allows the setting of the quantity to 5

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: the user tries to set the quantity of a product to 6
acceptance_criteria.then: the system prevents the setting and displays a message indicating the maximum limit is reached

CART.title: Save cart items for 30 days
CART.i_want: my cart items to be saved for 30 days
CART.so_that: I can continue shopping and return to my cart later

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: the user adds items to the cart
acceptance_criteria.then: the system saves the cart items for 30 days

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: the user logs out and returns after 31 days
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays a message indicating the cart items have expired

CART.title: Handle out of stock products
CART.i_want: to be notified when a product goes out of stock and moved to 'Saved for later'
CART.so_that: I am informed about the status of the product I want to purchase

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: a product goes out of stock
acceptance_criteria.then: the system moves the product to 'Saved for later' and notifies the user

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: a product is back in stock
acceptance_criteria.then: the system removes the product from 'Saved for later' and updates the cart

CART.title: Update cart total instantly
CART.i_want: the cart total to update instantly when the quantity of a product changes
CART.so_that: I can see the correct total at all times

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: the user changes the quantity of a product
acceptance_criteria.then: the system updates the cart total instantly

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: the user changes the quantity of a product to 0
acceptance_criteria.then: the system removes the product from the cart and updates the total

PAYMENT.title: Support multiple payment methods
PAYMENT.i_want: to be able to choose from UPI, credit card, debit card, and net banking as payment methods
PAYMENT.so_that: I can complete my purchase using the payment method I prefer

acceptance_criteria.given: the user selects UPI as the payment method
acceptance_criteria.when: the user completes the payment process
acceptance_criteria.then: the payment is processed via UPI

acceptance_criteria.given: the user selects a payment method other than UPI
acceptance_criteria.when: the user completes the payment process
acceptance_criteria.then: the payment is processed via the selected method

PAYMENT.title: Cash on Delivery for orders below ₹3,000
PAYMENT.i_want: to have the option to pay by cash on delivery for orders below ₹3,000
PAYMENT.so_that: I can choose this option if I prefer not to use online payment methods

acceptance_criteria.given: the user places an order for ₹2,500
acceptance_criteria.when: the user selects cash on delivery as the payment method
acceptance_criteria.then: the order is placed and the user can pay on delivery

acceptance_criteria.given: the user places an order for ₹3,500
acceptance_criteria.when: the user selects cash on delivery as the payment method
acceptance_criteria.then: the order is not placed and the user is informed that COD is not available for this amount

PAYMENT.title: Payment session times out after 8 minutes of inactivity
PAYMENT.i_want: the payment session to time out after 8 minutes of inactivity
PAYMENT.so_that: I am not left waiting indefinitely if I am not actively using the payment process

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is on the payment page
acceptance_criteria.when: the user does not interact with the page for 8 minutes
acceptance_criteria.then: the payment session times out and the user is prompted to start the process again

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is on the payment page
acceptance_criteria.when: the user interacts with the page within 8 minutes
acceptance_criteria.then: the payment session does not time out

PAYMENT.title: Maximum of 3 retries for failed payments
PAYMENT.i_want: to be able to retry a failed payment a maximum of 3 times per order
PAYMENT.so_that: I can complete my purchase if the initial payment attempt fails

acceptance_criteria.given: the user attempts to make a payment
acceptance_criteria.when: the payment fails
acceptance_criteria.then: the user is allowed to retry the payment up to 3 times

acceptance_criteria.given: the user attempts to make a payment
acceptance_criteria.when: the payment fails and the user retries 3 times
acceptance_criteria.then: the payment is not allowed to be retried further and the user is informed of the failure

PAYMENT.title: Order confirmation email sent within 2 minutes of successful payment
PAYMENT.i_want: to receive an order confirmation email within 2 minutes of a successful payment
PAYMENT.so_that: I can be assured that my order has been placed and is being processed

acceptance_criteria.given: the user makes a successful payment
acceptance_criteria.when: the payment is processed
acceptance_criteria.then: an order confirmation email is sent within 2 minutes

acceptance_criteria.given: the user makes a successful payment
acceptance_criteria.when: the payment is processed and the email is not sent within 2 minutes
acceptance_criteria.then: the user is informed of the delay in sending the confirmation email

REFUND.title: Request a refund within 10 days of delivery
REFUND.i_want: to request a refund for an item I received within 10 days of delivery
REFUND.so_that: I can get a refund for the item

acceptance_criteria.given: the item was delivered within 10 days
acceptance_criteria.when: I request a refund
acceptance_criteria.then: the refund request is accepted

acceptance_criteria.given: the item was delivered more than 10 days ago
acceptance_criteria.when: I request a refund
acceptance_criteria.then: the refund request is rejected

REFUND.title: Process UPI refunds within 3 working days
REFUND.i_want: to receive a refund for a UPI payment within 3 working days
REFUND.so_that: I can get my money back quickly

acceptance_criteria.given: the payment was made via UPI
acceptance_criteria.when: I request a refund
acceptance_criteria.then: the refund is processed within 3 working days

acceptance_criteria.given: the payment was not made via UPI
acceptance_criteria.when: I request a refund
acceptance_criteria.then: the refund is not processed within 3 working days

REFUND.title: Process card refunds within 7 working days
REFUND.i_want: to receive a refund for a card payment within 7 working days
REFUND.so_that: I can get my money back quickly

acceptance_criteria.given: the payment was made via card
acceptance_criteria.when: I request a refund
acceptance_criteria.then: the refund is processed within 7 working days

acceptance_criteria.given: the payment was not made via card
acceptance_criteria.when: I request a refund
acceptance_criteria.then: the refund is not processed within 7 working days

REFUND.title: Exclude 'Final Sale' items from refund requests
REFUND.i_want: to be informed that 'Final Sale' items are not eligible for refunds
REFUND.so_that: I do not waste time requesting a refund for an ineligible item

acceptance_criteria.given: I request a refund for a 'Final Sale' item
acceptance_criteria.when: I am informed about the eligibility
acceptance_criteria.then: I am informed that the item is not eligible for a refund

acceptance_criteria.given: I request a refund for a non-'Final Sale' item
acceptance_criteria.when: I am informed about the eligibility
acceptance_criteria.then: I am informed that the item is eligible for a refund

REFUND.title: Process partial refunds for multi-item orders
REFUND.i_want: to receive a partial refund for a multi-item order
REFUND.so_that: I can get a refund for the items I do not want

acceptance_criteria.given: I request a partial refund for a multi-item order
acceptance_criteria.when: the refund is processed
acceptance_criteria.then: a partial refund is issued

acceptance_criteria.given: I request a full refund for a multi-item order
acceptance_criteria.when: the refund is processed
acceptance_criteria.then: a full refund is not issued
